options: To put off an inspection that would show he'd been selling grain
fields.answer: To put off an inspection that would show he'd been selling grain

hints: [[c:Which object was moved to the steward's store?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It was ]]Mr Vale[[c:, the steward. He hid the order to put off an inspection that would have shown he'd been selling grain for himself, and it was in the blue dispatch chest. The order is found, the winter grain can be given out, and the accounts will be checked. ]]Martha[[c: only gave grain to a hungry family, which was kind. ]]Mr Vale[[c: lied to protect himself.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:You can solve this from your notebook alone.]]
